snippet.title: Château Pluie: The New Cellar Keeper — Official Trailer | Cozy Wine Cellar Sorter
snippet.description:
Step into the cellar of Château Pluie, a cozy sorting game about organizing wine bottles by region and color, set to the slow rhythm of rain against stone walls.
No rush. No danger. Just satisfying, tactile organization in a warm, atmospheric cellar — perfect for unwinding after a long day.
🍷 Sort and arrange bottles by region and color
🌧️ Ambient rain, warm lighting, zero time pressure
🎧 Best played with headphones and a cup of tea
Wishlist now on Steam
#CozyGame #IndieGame #ChateauPluie #Simulation
